name: Tiger 2
subtitle: UCLA cut
goal: Get the point guard a layup by cutting off the high-post screen.
options: Best: 1 on the UCLA cut. Next: 5 curling down the lane, then 4 at the elbow for the jump shot.

steps.note: 4 screens for 1. 1 cuts hard off 4's shoulder to the block. That is the UCLA cut. 2 looks for the layup pass.
Not there? All at once: 1 clears out to the far wing, 3 fills the top, and 4 sets a screen away for 5.
5 curls off the screen and down the right side of the lane, looking for the pass inside.
4 returns to the elbow for a pass and the elbow jump shot. 5 goes back to the other elbow. We are back in our starting spots and can reverse it from here.
